# gramlot-js-server 0.3.29 — asset revalidation and core page policy

- `gramlot.js` and the themes are revalidated with `ETag` and `Last-Modified`; a matching conditional request gets 304 instead of the full file.
- The page policy is composed by the core: with libraries from jsDelivr it carries the CDN origin.
- New option `librarySource` (`cdn` default, `local`).
- The page template of `npm create @gramlot` is served from a `pages` folder; `npm start` works on a fresh project.
- Requires @gramlot/gramlot 0.3.34 (third-party libraries loaded on first use).
- Tests and browser checks follow the gallery of gramlot-examples 0.3.41; slow tests have an explicit timeout for `bun test`.

Qualification: full test suite green on GitHub Actions (Node and Bun, serverless exports and gallery in Chromium).
